storage: Airtight jar in a cool, dry cupboard for 6 to 12 months. In Mumbai's monsoon keep it dry and away from sunlight. Soaked or ground batter keeps about 1 day in the fridge.
looksLike: Small, flat, pale-yellow half-beans with the green skin removed. They cook soft and creamy and turn a deeper yellow.
howToPick: Even, pale-yellow split dal with no green or dark bits, no dust, no holes and no musty smell. Dull or mixed colours suggest old or blended stock.
shelfLife: About 6 to 12 months in a sealed pack (check the best-before date).
substitutes: Moong chilka (split green moong with skin)

vendorListings.product: Tata Sampann Unpolished Moong Dal Split

usedIn.raw: 50 g dry split yellow moong dal per serving (about ¼ cup; 100–110 g after soaking)
